subject: SIG: RTO/RPO attestations + witness scheduling for PaymentFlows
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@paymentflows.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG/BCP follow-up — RTO/RPO artifacts for PaymentFlows evaluation

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. As part of PaymentFlows' SIG intake we want to provide the operational artifacts you requested to validate our business continuity and recovery posture. To keep this tight for procurement and your risk team, can you confirm the specific items you need from the list below and the preferred delivery method (SFTP / Drive link / witness call):

- Latest RTO/RPO snapshot (by region) — we can provide the spreadsheet and raw timing samples
- Recent warm-failover trace and keystore handoff log (redacted)
- Service runbook excerpt (failover steps and escalation contacts)
- Witness window for a short 30-min Q&A (Ops + Engineering)

If you prefer, we can also produce a brief cover memo mapping each artifact to SIG/BP sections.

Proposed timeline: we can assemble the artifacts and a secured Drive folder by end of day Friday (7/11). Let me know any hard deadlines from procurement.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Security & Compliance Liaison
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message

From: Elena Martinez <elena@paymentflows.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@paymentflows.com>, Rohit Singh <rohit@paymentflows.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 11:43:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG/BCP follow-up — RTO/RPO artifacts for PaymentFlows evaluation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — your plan sounds good. The risk team specifically asked for:

1) RTO/RPO snapshot for the US region + a brief note on how cache warm times are measured
2) Warm-failover trace for the most recent monthly exercise (we only need the timeline and key ops steps, redacted hostnames are fine)
3) The section of the runbook that covers keystore/backup restore and recovery verification steps

Procurement has a hard deadline of 7/15 for completing their vendor review. If you can get the artifacts to us by 7/11 that's perfect.

We'd like a 30-min witness call the week of 7/14 for our security lead to ask 2–3 clarifying questions. Can you propose 2x 30-min slots?

Also — please send any attestation language you recommend for our SIG intake form (we'll paste it into the checklist).

Regards,
Elena Martinez
Director, Security & Risk
PaymentFlows Inc.

Attachments: paymentflows-sig-intake-form.pdf (attached)

Marissa / Grace,

Noted — I can assemble the RTO/RPO snapshot and the warm-failover timeline. Karthik, can you pull the warm-failover trace and the keystore handoff log from the 2025-06-30 run? We should redact hostnames and any customer identifiers. Aim: deliver sanitized artifacts + mapping memo by 7/11 EOD.

Karthik: The runbook excerpt (keystore/restore) is in Confluence under ops/runbooks/recovery-v3.2. Grace, can you draft a one-paragraph attestation we can paste into their SIG form? Keep it brief and factual (no legal language).

I'll also prepare a short artifact index (spreadsheet) listing files and the SIG sections they map to.

Thanks — Ben

Redwood Inference

Artifacts provided are representative samples and are redacted to remove tenant-specific identifiers."
